quest.title: Back on One's Feet
quest.description: You've made it out of the sewer. Now, go look for Nastya at the "town entrance" she told you about earlier.

talks.objective: Get inside the town of Okurov

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...All I'm gonna do is toss those frogs into his house, and then... wait to see his face when he comes back to a house going, "Ribbit, ribbit!" Heh heh, it's gonna be so funny!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: He's a Badbug... Would you help me please, Aunt LePuy? Would you help me get the key...?

dialogues.speaker: Aunt LePuy
dialogues.text: ...Believe... family...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally! Nastya! Nastya, we're over here!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: #Yaaaay! {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}! Paimonka! You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for you for so long... Zala is so mad, though. Maybe she thinks the two of you are baddies or Volkodlak or something.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I saw the two of you just drop into that big, black hole... It was so big... and so deep... Ugh, I didn't even dare to look inside.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But I knew that the two of you would make your way out anyhow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It wasn't easy, mind you... But never mind. Right now, we have a few questions for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you have a family member here named Koshchei, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I don't think I've heard that name before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I don't know everyone's names, though. But if you wanna know, Paimonka, you should talk to Doctor Moreau... The Doctor knows everything and everyone's names.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: When you turn into a tree, slowly you won't be able to talk anymore. And everyone else will start forgetting your name too. Only Doctor Moreau remembers all those names...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Turn into a tree"... Hold on, so you mean to say that the Leshy here all used to be human!?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: "Leshy"? What's that? Anyway, whatever that is, that's not us... what Aunt LePuy and the others have almost completely turned into are the Perfect Tree...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But right now, I'm only half-tree... And it's all those Volkodlak's fault! Otherwise, I'd be exactly where they are now instead of being so far behind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So how do you communicate with each other?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Once I turn into a Perfect Tree, I'll be able to talk to the other trees just by touching their leaves with mine! And my roots will be joined with to everyone's too...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Doctor Moreau said, "Let us become one family, and grow a world that is warm and where pain is no more. Let us come together, so we may reach..."

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: "That eternal courtyard that is free of all worries."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Hmm, {NICKNAME}... Might this "Doctor Moreau" really be...)

choices.text: (He might just be Koshchei the Deathless.)

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: From my perspective, that is a highly logical deduction.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Ooh! You think so too, Goggles? But what are we supposed to do now then...?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Let's just follow Nastya for now.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Yeah, that makes sense. As long as we follow Nastya, we'll meet that Doctor Moreau — Koshchei the Deathless...)

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #{M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}! Paimonka! What are you two whispering to each other about???

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...WHOA! Um... N—Nothing! We are just... just really interested in Doctor Moreau! Can you tell us more about him?

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Heh, of course! Ever since he came to Ogurov, the town has become really nice and warm. All the ice and snow has melted into these creeks, and you can see so many trees with pretty leaves coming out from the ground now.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: He's made everyone better, too! Mama's leg stopped hurting after he started helping her, and her eyes stopped being so red and watery too...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Everyone's stopped fighting, too. Even the ones who had been at each other's throats forever... Now, they hold each other's hand in theirs and have become family...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: ...Is that why you two want to be my family? Zala will definitely stop being mad at you if you do that.

choices.text: It does sound like it comes with plenty of benefits.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hey! Are you joking... or are you serious!?)

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #Awesome! I bet that when you become my family, {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, you will grow the most beautiful leaves!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, the most important thing for us now is to get Nastya home!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mentioned before that your home is at that tall assembly hall all the way over there, right? So how do we get there?

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: There's an elevator over there that goes up. But... "No-Nose" Ove has probably hidden the <color=#00E1FFFF>Control Wheel</color> for the elevator in his house.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: He doesn't like us, and I detest him too. He's not gonna give it to us if we ask for it.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: But without the Control Wheel, we can't take the elevator to the assembly hall...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Show us the way to his house, Nastya. We'll take a look first. When there's a will, there's a way — and we'll find it.

choices.text: It's all very tempting, but I'll have to think about it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, this is a serious matter that calls for serious consideration.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: #...Okay then. I hope you will join us after you're done considering. {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME} will definitely have the prettiest leaves!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (That's right. You must have thought of it too. He could be that Koshchei the Deathless!)

talks.objective: Head to location near Ove's house

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Okay, we're here... And he's still standing there at the door.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Looks like talking it out isn't an option here... Nastya, how about just ask him for the Control Wheel outright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if he really hates you, there's no way he'd stand in the way of a child trying to get home!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: That's where you're wrong, Paimonka. He will never give us the Control Wheel.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: He has always stopped us from going to the assembly hall... Every time we were supposed to see our families there, he'd catch us and lock us up in his cellar. But sometimes, he would give us yummy food, too...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: That's me and my friends. He always locked all of us up together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? And no one else in town cared that he was doing that???

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: It was always only for one night, just so we couldn't get to the assembly hall in time. And even if we told on him, our parents would just think we played too long and made up an excuse or something.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Nobody knows why he keeps doing that. But we're always getting scolded because of him.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I always thought he was one of those Badbugs. You know, the kind you're supposed to just burn to make a new, healthy tree. But too bad the Doctor and Zala don't see it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's why you gave him that awful nickname... Yeah, Paimon would be mad too if someone got her into trouble like that! But it doesn't seem like we can just demand the Control Wheel from him...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, I've been on his roof to toss frogs into his house before. You should be able to find a way to sneak in from there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a minute...! Tossing frogs into someone's house? That's something only naughty kids do!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I know... But I only do bad things to him when he does bad things to us. And we totally play fair. If he catches five of us, then we toss five frogs over the wall.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But since there's no one here to help me with the ladder... Um... I don't think I can get up there. Could you get in there to find the Control Wheel?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, you've come to the right people! We'll get it to you in no time.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: I'll wait for you outside, then! Be careful!

choices.text: We'll have to find two more frogs to chuck at the house this time then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey, don't say that!!! He's not gonna catch us! And we'll definitely find the Control Wheel...

talks.objective: Try to get inside Ove's house

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: What is it? Is something wrong?

choices.text: I want to try persuading Ove into giving us the Control Wheel.

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: You want to... persuade "No-Nose" Ove??? No way that will be easier than just beating him in a fight!

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: But since he's standing right there, I guess you can try if you want... But if it looks like he's gonna beat you up, just run!!!

choices.text: I'm familiarizing myself with the infiltration route...

response.speaker: Nastya
response.text: Good idea! You gotta look really carefully and make a super good plan. Good luck, you guys!

talks.objective: Check out the inside of the house

dialogues.speaker: Ove
dialogues.text: ...UGFFFF... Must not... go... Close...

choices.text: We would like to have the elevator key...

response.speaker: Ove
response.text: Prote... never... you.. mind...

dialogues.speaker: Ove
dialogues.text: ...Get... water... No, milk... bread... and... sugar... cubes...

choices.text: Will you still need all that food after you turn into a Leshy?

response.speaker: Ove
response.text: ...First... catch... frogs...

response.speaker: Ove
response.text: Keep... kids... from... hall... tomorrow...

choices.text: These are all foods that kids would like...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Ooh, you're back! Did you find the Control Wheel?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Heh, of course! That was a piece of cake for us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: HEY! That's Paimon's line!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But now that we have the Control Wheel, that means we can take the elevator to the assembly hall, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah! Let's go right now! Mom and Dad and everyone else must be worried... Quick, come with me!

talks.objective: Take the elevator to the assembly hall
